fullGameBoost: refresh_rate=120; echo '█▓▒▒░░░ Starting Ultimate All-in-One Boost (NON-ROOT) ░░░▒▒▓█'; echo 'Target: MAX FPS | Game: {packageName}'; sleep 1; echo '--- 1. Eliminating UI & Touch Latency ---'; settings put global window_animation_scale 0.0; settings put global transition_animation_scale 0.0; settings put global animator_duration_scale 0.0; settings put global disable_window_blurs 1; settings put global block_untrusted_touches 0; settings put system touch.pressure.scale 0.001; settings put system scroll_friction 0.010; settings put system high_touch_sensitivity_enable 1; settings put secure long_press_timeout 200; settings put secure multi_press_timeout 200; echo '[✔] Animations & Touch Latency Optimized.'; sleep 1; echo '--- 2. Activating Peak Performance Mode ---'; cmd power set-mode 0; dumpsys deviceidle disable; settings put global low_power 0; settings put global performance_mode 1; settings put global stay_on_while_plugged_in 3; echo '[✔] Doze mode disabled, max performance mode activated.'; sleep 1; echo '--- 4. Forcing Absolute MAX Hz & Disabling Adaptive FPS ---'; settings put secure user_refresh_rate $refresh_rate; settings put system min_refresh_rate $refresh_rate; settings put system peak_refresh_rate $refresh_rate; settings put global min_fps $refresh_rate; settings put global max_fps $refresh_rate; settings put system power.dfps.level 0; settings put system disable_idle_fps true; settings put system display.disable_dynamic_fps 1; settings put system display.disable_mitigated_fps 1; settings put global dfps.enable false; settings put global smart_dfps.enable false; settings put global fps.switch.thermal false; echo '[✔] Refresh rate locked to max, adaptive systems disabled.'; sleep 1; echo '--- 5. Optimizing Network & Storage I/O ---'; settings put global network_scoring_ui_enabled 0; settings put global auto_sync 0; setprop net.ipv4.tcp_timestamps 0; setprop net.ipv4.tcp_sack 1; setprop net.ipv4.tcp_tw_reuse 1; setprop net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen 3; setprop net.tcp.buffersize.default 4096,1048576,2097152,4096,1048576,2097152; setprop persist.sys.ssr.enable_ramdumps 0; echo '[✔] Network stack optimized, RAM Dumps disabled.'; sleep 1; echo '--- 7. Finalizing for {packageName} & Flushing Memory ---'; am set-standby-bucket {packageName} active; dumpsys deviceidle whitelist +{packageName}; am force-stop {packageName}; sync; sm fstrim; dumpsys meminfo --clear-all-caches; echo '[✔] Game prioritized to Active Bucket and system memory flushed.'; echo ''; echo '█▓▒▒░░░ ULTIMATE NON-ROOT BOOST COMPLETE! utilityRamClean: echo '█▓▒▒░░░ CLEANING RAM & SYSTEM CACHES (NON-ROOT) ░░░▒▒▓█'; am kill-all; sync; dumpsys meminfo --clear-all-caches; echo '[✔] RAM and system memory caches cleared successfully.'; echo '█▓▒▒░░░ RAM CLEAN COMPLETE ░░░▒▒▓█'
utilityStorageClean: echo '█▓▒▒░░░ DEEP CLEANING STORAGE CACHE (NON-ROOT) ░░░▒▒▓█'; rm -rf /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/*/cache/* 2>/dev/null; sm fstrim; echo '[✔] Cleared caches and executed fstrim for storage I/O optimization.'; echo '█▓▒▒░░░ CACHE CLEAN COMPLETE ░░░▒▒▓█'
